Wife allegedly murders husband, buries body in bathroom in Agra

In Agra, a wife has been accused of murdering her husband and burying his body in the bathroom. The incident came to light after 45 days. According to police, the wife allegedly administered sleeping pills in his food, then killed him and concealed the body by plastering over it in the bathroom.
